name: Native Android Container & Cordova WebView Shell
description: Native Android application shell hosting an Apache Cordova container with Ionic WebView local asset server for high-performance React UI execution.
behavior_summary: Initializes CordovaActivity, starts local HTTP asset server to prevent CORS issues, and coordinates WebAppReady handshake with JavaScript runtime.

reusability_assessment.notes: Reference for hybrid WebView container architectures, superseded by native Flutter shell in Family OS.

name: Biometric Authentication Gate
description: BiometricPrompt authentication layer enforcing parent identity verification before granting access to parental rules and configuration.
behavior_summary: Prompts user for fingerprint or device credentials, caching validation state to safeguard rules from unauthorized child modification.

reusability_assessment.notes: Adapts directly into Flutter local_auth biometric parental gate (S1-01 / S1-02).

name: Native Request Signer & HMAC Generator
description: Native C/C++ library libsigner.so generating cryptographic HMAC signatures and anti-tamper telemetry tokens for secure outbound requests.
behavior_summary: Loads libsigner.so via JNI, executes nSign() to generate signature headers (adj_sig_v3) preventing replay and request manipulation.

reusability_assessment.notes: Commercial Adjust SDK native library. Cleanroom HMAC-SHA256 request signing implemented in Dart/C++ for Family OS API layer.

name: Push Command & Remote Notification Router
description: FCM push notification service and command dispatcher routing instant lock commands, policy updates, and emergency panic alerts.
behavior_summary: Receives high-priority FCM messages, wakes background services, and forwards payloads to the local web application store.

reusability_assessment.notes: Maps to Family OS unified push notification router (S1-08).

name: Recovered TypeScript & React 18 Architecture
description: Complete recovered source tree of 2,332 files (1,994 TypeScript, 20 JavaScript, 318 visual assets) structured with Redux Ducks and Immutable.js models.
behavior_summary: Manages UI component hierarchy, 250 Redux Duck state modules, Immutable.js data records, and RxJS epic side-effect streams.

reusability_assessment.notes: Recovered proprietary TypeScript codebase used exclusively as behavioral and structural benchmark reference for cleanroom Flutter models.

name: REST API Client Core
description: Comprehensive API client qapi.ts (1,634 lines) coordinating 96 endpoint groups and 130 HTTP method invocations across 5 cloud hosts.
behavior_summary: Encapsulates REST endpoints, appends platform and device telemetry headers, handles parameter transformation and error parsing.

reusability_assessment.notes: Direct reference for Family OS REST API client and domain endpoint catalog.

name: OAuth2 Token Lifecycle & Transparent Silent Refresh
description: Resilient OAuth2 token refresh interceptor catching HTTP 401 Unauthorized errors and replaying in-flight requests transparently.
behavior_summary: Intercepts 401 response, requests renewed bearer token using refresh_token grant, persists new tokens, and transparently retries original request.

reusability_assessment.notes: Standard RFC 6749 OAuth2 refresh interceptor pattern, implemented in Dio / Dart for Family OS.

name: Multi-Device & Family Profile Hierarchy
description: Domain data model defining parent accounts, child profiles, supervised devices, school partner students, and device permissions.
behavior_summary: Models multi-tier entity relationships linking master account UIDs to individual kid profiles and delegated device hardware records.

reusability_assessment.notes: Informs Family Account & Circles Domain Model (S1-02).

name: Daily Quota & 1440-Minute Mathematical Constraint Engine
description: Mathematical validation and enforcement algorithm enforcing a strict 1440-minute daily constraint across divided schedule intervals.
behavior_summary: Calculates remaining screen time allowance, verifying sum(daily_minutes) <= 1440 and triggering quota exhaustion lockout.

reusability_assessment.notes: Direct cleanroom algorithm candidate for Family OS screen time engine (S2-01).

name: Schedule & Routine Conflict Resolution State Machine
description: Hierarchical conflict resolution engine prioritizing Bedtime lock over School routine lock over Daily Quota expiration.
behavior_summary: Evaluates active schedules using strict precedence rules to determine real-time device restriction state.

reusability_assessment.notes: Core logic aligns with Family OS routine and calendar enforcement (S1-06 / S2-01).

name: Local DNS & Web Filtering Engine Specification
description: Loopback DNS interception algorithm parsing RFC 1035 wire packets on local port 53 and generating NXDOMAIN responses for blocked categories.
behavior_summary: Intercepts UDP port 53 packets via local VpnService, matches FQDNs against 31 categories, and returns synthetic 127.0.0.1 or NXDOMAIN for blocked domains.

reusability_assessment.notes: Foundational architectural reference for Family OS private local web filter (S2-03).

name: SafeSearch & VIP IP Domain Rewriting Engine
description: SafeSearch enforcement pipeline redirecting major search engine queries to strict VIP IPs and injecting safe search URL parameters.
behavior_summary: Maps Google to 216.239.38.120, Bing to 204.79.197.220, and YouTube to 216.239.38.119, overriding user search settings in incognito mode.

reusability_assessment.notes: Direct cleanroom implementation for child web safety in Family OS (S2-03).

name: Debounced Geofencing & Location Engine
description: Geofence boundary transition algorithm utilizing Haversine distance with 8000ms debounce and 15m hysteresis filtering to suppress GPS jitter.
behavior_summary: Calculates great-circle distance between GPS coordinates and place centers, holding exit transitions until boundary is cleared by 15m for 8 seconds.

reusability_assessment.notes: Adapts into Family OS smart location and place alert pipeline (S1-07 / S2-04).

name: Behavioral & Social Media Activity Monitoring Pipeline
description: Activity monitoring architecture capturing call logs, SMS metadata, YouTube video search queries, and social network threat alerts.
behavior_summary: Gathers device activity telemetry, extracts search keywords, and provides aggregated safety timelines to parent dashboards.

reusability_assessment.notes: Subject to strict COPPA/GDPR-K privacy controls in Family OS on-device intelligence.

name: Panic SOS Event Hub
description: Emergency alert system providing an interactive SOS trigger, 5-second false-alarm cancellation grace window, and high-priority push broadcasting.
behavior_summary: Initiates 5-second countdown upon child SOS activation; upon completion, dispatches EventType 500 alert with precise GPS and battery status.

reusability_assessment.notes: Directly informs Emergency SOS & Escalation Protocols (S1-07).

name: Multi-Tier Local Persistence & Firestore Offline Cache
description: Comprehensive local offline persistence layer comprising 22 SQLite tables (15 Firestore v16 + 6 DataTransport v7 + 1 NativeStorage KV) and 26 persistent preference keys.
behavior_summary: Maintains cached document snapshots, offline mutation queues, and multi-process atomic counters to ensure offline policy enforcement.

reusability_assessment.notes: Informs offline-first Drift/SQLite persistence architecture for Family OS (S1-01 / S1-02).

name: School & Linewize Community Digital Safety System
description: Integrates school digital safety, in-school period restrictions, Linewize event alerts, and student profile delegation.

name: YouTube Supervision & Watched Video Analytics Engine
description: Governs YouTube restricted mode, search query monitoring, watched video history, and channel blocking.

name: Calls & SMS Supervision Subsystem
description: Configures supervised contacts, call logs, SMS text message monitoring, and contact-specific blocking rules.

name: Commercial Licensing & In-App Entitlements Engine
description: Manages feature gating, Google Play in-app purchases, trial activation, and license entitlement matrix resolution.
